(FAQ)

Questions

What do I get for $400?

Up to 5 responsive pages on Webflow or Shopify using your logo, copy and photos, with base features: one contact or booking form, basic SEO titles and descriptions, mobile testing, one revision round and launch support. Extra pages, copywriting, shoots and custom features are quoted before you pay.

Webflow or Shopify?

Shopify if you sell products online, Webflow for almost everything else. We recommend one on the first call.

How long does a website take?

Most sites launch in 2 to 4 weeks once we have your content. Packages with a shoot add the shoot day to the schedule.

Can I edit the site myself?

Yes. Both platforms have simple editors and we show you how to use them. Website Care covers edits if you would rather not.

What is not included?

Platform and domain fees are paid directly to the platform. Every package lists exactly what is and is not included on the pricing page.
